values.note: 'All sites are $50 per night.' Campers get discounts on the splash pad, climbing wall and boat rentals.

'Reservations are required', on Florence County's own reservation site (LRCP Family Campground). Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am; entry codes are emailed by 10 am on arrival day and guests go straight to their site. 14-night maximum.

booking.source: https://www.lynchesriverpark.com/family-campground ('Reservations are required'; 'Please visit https://reservation.florenceco.org/ to view availability and book sites'; 'Stays are limited to a 14-night maximum') + Campground Rules and Regulations PDF ('Reservations are required'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.lynchesriverpark.com/family-campground ('20, 30, and 50 amp; 110 and 240 outlets are available at each site') + Campground Rules and Regulations PDF ('Please use designated dump station to empty all waste water tanks'; sewer at the site, read from the note, is not stated and the rules send all waste water to the dump station, so it is cleared), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Each site can accommodate RVs from 60 to 157 feet' (site lengths on the campground map). One RV and one tent, or up to three tents, per site; 6 guests and 2 vehicles.

sites.source: https://www.lynchesriverpark.com/family-campground ('Each site can accommodate RVs from 60 to 157 feet (see map below for site specs)'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.lynchesriverpark.com/_files/ugd/002839_da8b5c5b296342b2837261bfade1b429.pdf (Campground Rules and Regulations: 'the dumpster located at the Dump Station'; 'use designated dump station'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florence County Parks & Rec park on the Lynches Scenic River between Florence and Lake City. --Claude
summary: Park's own campground page: booking FCFS/not reservable -> reservations required on Florence County's reservation site, 14-night max; fees added $50/night flat; 50 A electric confirmed, derived sewer cleared (rules send all waste water to the dump station); dump station added.
